'''Green-rated constable''' was one of the nine ranks of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]], the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] branch of [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]], the corporation that ruled the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Like the other eight ranks of the Constable Brigade, the rank corresponded to a [[Color/Legends|color]] of the visible spectrum. Green-rated contables ranked directly above [[yellow-rated constable]] and below [[blue-rated constable]]. The constables served as regional leaders in the Brigade, and their authority extended to all SoroSuub property.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of green-rated constable was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
